statement: The pinned Linux xpad consumer does not expose Xbox 360 headset audio as an ALSA USB Audio Class device, and the inspected USB-audio quirk and mixer-map tables do not provide a model-specific Xbox 360 UAC descriptor. The physical wired Xbox 360 headset transport's UAC revision (if applicable), PCM rates, output/capture channel roles, mute/volume feature units, audio terminal types, and isochronous endpoint packet limits are therefore unknown from these sources. A functional stereo/mono sidecar is not native XInput headset compatibility; absence of a table entry does not establish absence of proprietary headset audio.

applicability.scope: Source-only wired Xbox 360 consumer audit; device-side proprietary headset behavior and descriptors were not captured.
